author: itsbenjamin
quote: An absolute masterpiece from beginning to end. The updated visuals are beautiful, the gameplay feels fantastic, and the atmosphere is unmatched. Everything that made the original so special has been preserved and improved upon. This is exactly how a remake should be done. Easily one of the best gaming experiences I’ve had in years. 10/10.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: itsbenjamin
quote: GTA 6 is a massive disappointment. The story is boring, poorly written, and drags on far too long. The graphics look incredible, but that’s where the praise ends. Performance is terrible, with constant frame drops, bugs, and glitches. For a game with this much hype, I expected significantly better.
